## Change

Describe what this pull request changes in the lab.

## Risk

Who or what could be affected if this is applied. Call out sign-on, group membership, conditional access, and certificate material.

## Rollback

How to return to the previous state. For a Terraform apply, link the rollback runbook and name the commit you would return to.

## Test

What you ran, and what a reviewer can run. Include `make test` for Python changes and the plan result for Terraform changes.
